def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not is_using_api_key():
        header = ['   REMEDIATIONS']
        content = [
            """
  1 vulnerability was reported in 1 package. For detailed remediation & fix 
  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. 
"""
        ]
        footer = ['+==============================================================================+']
        return header + content + footer

    header = ['   REMEDIATIONS']
    content = []
    footer = ['+==============================================================================+']

    for pkg_name, pkg_data in remediations.items():
        for version, data in pkg_data.items():
            vulnerabilities_found = data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            version_str = data.get('version', '')
            recommended_version = data.get('recommended_version', '')
            other_recommended_versions = data.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
            more_info_url = data.get('more_info_url', '')
            requirement = data.get('requirement', None)
            secure_versions = data.get('secure_versions', [])
            closest_secure_version = data.get('closest_secure_version', {})

            if not recommended_version:
                continue

            content.append(f"""
-> {pkg_name} version {version_str} was found, which has {vulnerabilities_found} vulnerability
   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {recommended_version}
""")

            if other_recommended_versions:
                other_versions_str = ', '.join(other_recommended_versions)
                content.append(f"""{' ' * 78}
   We recommend updating to version {recommended_version} of {pkg_name}. Other versions
   without known vulnerabilities are: {other_versions_str}
""")

            content.append(f"""{' ' * 78}
   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit
   {more_info_url}
   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.
""")
            content.append(f"{' ' * 78}")

    return header + content + footer


def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    if not text:
        return ''

    if styling is None:
        styling = {}

    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    if not text.strip():
        return text

    if max_lines is not None:
        lines = text.split('\n')
        if len(lines) > max_lines:
            lines = lines[:max_lines]
            text = '\n'.join(lines)

    wrapped_text = textwrap.fill(text, width=columns - len(indent) - len(sub_indent), initial_indent=indent, subsequent_indent=sub_indent)
    
    if color:
        wrapped_text = click.style(wrapped_text, fg=color)

    return wrapped_text
